question: Who among the following is considered as the father of the world wide web?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee**

 
 
• ​Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee also known as **TimBL.**
 
• He is an** English computer scientist** best known as the inventor of the World Wide Web.
 
• He is a Professorial Fellow of Computer Science at the University of Oxford.
 
• He is a professor at the **Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).**
 
• Berners-Lee is the **director** of the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
 
• He co-founded the **World Wide Web Foundation. **
 
• He is considered as** the father of the world wide web.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robert Cailliau**

 
 
• **​**Robert Cailliau is a Belgian informatics engineer, **computer scientist** and author.
 
• He proposed the first hypertext system for **CERN in 1987.**
 
• He collaborated with Tim Berners-Lee on the World Wide Web.
 
• He designed the historical** logo of the WWW.**
 
 
 
• **Pei-Yuan Wei**
 
 
• **​**Pei-Yuan Wei is a **Taiwanese-American businessman.**
 
• He created **ViolaWWW**, the first popular graphical web browser.
 
• Wei was a founding employee of Global Network Navigator.
 
 
 
• **James H. Clark**
 
 
• **​**James Henry Clark is an American entrepreneur and **computer scientist.**
 
• He founded several notable Silicon Valley technology companies, including Silicon Graphics, Netscape, myCFO, and Healtheon.
 
• His research work in computer graphics led to the development of systems for the fast rendering of three-dimensional computer images.
